resources.string: How do I use Pixel Pocket
Why is your app not working
Copy all your .gb ROM files into a directory on your device and select it. This gives pixel pocket access to all files in this directory. After the scan is complete, you should see your games
If your games are compressed, try unzipping them. Go to settings and try rescanning your directory. Else report problem on github issues. Also post a fix please.

Emulation of game boy is totally legal. What is not legal is piracy of ROMs. Thus, you the user, have to acquire ROMs yourself and the server has been shutdown. I love piracy but Nintendo does not. As for adds and privacy. There will never be adds on this app and you can check the source code for yourself here:
Pixel Pocket needs to scan a directory containing Game Boy ROMs. This might take a few seconds.
